name: Race the Clock 2017

venue.name: [Roseville Library - Ramsey County](https://www.rclreads.org/about/locations/rcl-roseville)
venue.details: Go through the main entrance and the "Community Meeting room" is on the right.

information:
3x3 Round 2 will be a 24 person Head-to-Head best of 1 round. 
Please read the "Head-to-Head" tab to see more information.

The competition is FREE for all competitiors. The online registration fee is $5 but is only a holder to ensure your spot in the competition. You can request the registration fee back at the competition by talking to Walker Welch. If you are having trouble paying, then email us to get everything sorted out.
